VICTOIRE de Ornn

Patched Porobot.tx: (I enter exhausted.) When you play me, if you control 3 or more other gear, draw 1.

Mask of Foresight.tx: When a friendly unit attacks or defends alone, give it +1 might this turn.

Bard, Mercurial.tx: You may exhaust your legend as an additional cost to play me. When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move any number of your units to an open battlefield.

Plundering Poro.tx: When I conquer, play a Gold gear token exhausted.

Ornn, Blacksmith.tx: When you play me or when I hold, look at the top 4 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a gear from among them and draw it. Then recycle the rest.

Singularity.tx: Deal 6 to each of up to two units.

Ornn, Fire Below the Mountain.tx: exhaust: [Reaction] — [Add] 1 rune of any type. Use only to play gear or use gear abilities. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

Pit Crew.tx: When you play a gear, ready me.

Hidden Blade.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Kill a unit at a battlefield. Its controller draws 2.

Shepherd's Heirloom.tx: When you play this, gain 1 XP. [Equip] — Spend 1 XP (Pay the cost: Attach this to a unit you control.)

Seal of Focus.tx: exhaust: [Reaction] — [Add] 1 calm rune. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

Hostile Takeover.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) Take control of an enemy unit at a battlefield. Ready it. (Start a combat if other enemies are there. Otherwise, conquer.) Lose control of that unit and recall it at end of turn. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)

Thousand-Tailed Watcher.tx: [Accelerate] (You may pay 1 energy and 1 mind rune as an additional cost to have me enter ready.) When you play me, give enemy units -3 might this turn, to a minimum of 1 might.

Renata Glasc, Chem-Baroness.tx: When you or an ally hold, you may exhaust me to play a Gold gear token exhausted. While your score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, your Gold [ADD] an additional 1 energy.

Brutalizer.tx: [Equip] 1 calm rune (1 calm rune: Attach this to a unit you control.)

Guardian Angel.tx: [Equip] 1 calm rune (1 calm rune: Attach this to a unit you control.)

Kennen, Keeper of Balance.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) When you play me or I attack, you may pay 2 energy to [Stun] a unit. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.) While there's a stunned enemy unit here, I have +2 might.

Sterak's Gage.tx: [Quick-Draw] (This has [Reaction]. When you play it, attach it to a unit you control.) [Equip] 1 calm rune (1 calm rune: Attach this to a unit you control.)

Enthralling Protector.tx: [Hunt] (When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.) Spend 2 XP: [Buff] me. (Give me a +1 might buff if I don't have one.)

Vi, Peacekeeper.tx: [Ambush] (You may play me as a [Reaction] to a battlefield where you have units.) When I attack, [Stun] an enemy unit here. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

Ki Barrier.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Choose a unit. Prevent the next 7 damage that would be dealt to it this turn. (Opponents can assign it extra combat damage to kill it.)

Renata Glasc, Mastermind.tx: 1 energy and 1 mind rune: Draw 1. 4 energy and 4 mind runes, exhaust: Score 1 point. Use my abilities only while I'm at a battlefield.

Defy.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Counter a spell that costs no more than 4 energy and no more than 1 rune of any type.

Sprite Burst.tx: Play two ready 3 might Sprite unit tokens with [Temporary]. (Kill each at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)

Helm of Suppression.tx: [Empower] 4 energy and 1 calm rune (4 energy and 1 calm rune: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.) Opponents' spells cost 1 energy more. If this is [Empowered], they cost 1 energy and 1 rune of any type more instead.

Deathgrip.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Kill a friendly unit to give +might equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.

Aspiring Engineer.tx: When you play me, return a gear from your trash to your hand.

Lecturing Yordle.tx: [Tank] (I must be assigned combat damage first.) When you play me, draw 1.

Time Warp.tx: Take a turn after this one. Banish this.
